summary.prose: Revision 3 per re-review feedback r2. Standalone small bugfix for ISSUE-1e2052060dec3efb: syncManifest v3 in vscode-plugin/scripts/sync-manifest-catalog.mjs owns the whole backend-derived manifest surface — (a) ONE shared row map (catalog rows whose insrc.<path> key is not plugin-local: excludes insrc.chat.* and the insrc.models.tasks.* prefix) drives BOTH update and insertion of catalog-backed keys; (b) a separate taxonomy pass owns the ENTIRE per-role prefix: every insrc.models.tasks.* key in every section is deleted, then the canonical "Models — per-role tiers" section is regenerated from buildPerRoleKeyMap() (created if missing; existing key order kept, new roles appended in taxonomy order); (c) DUPLICATE-TITLED sections get a lossless conflict policy: the FIRST section keeps its title and ALL section-level metadata; properties merge first-wins in section order, so distinct local properties from later duplicates survive; a key present in multiple duplicate-titled sections with CONFLICTING schemas is refused with a sync-duplicate-conflict diagnostic naming the key and both sections (ambiguous — cannot be repaired safely); (d) missing catalog-group sections are created, not thrown; (e) unrelated plugin-local keys are preserved everywhere, including inside the canonical per-role section. Stored setting VALUES are never rewritten — schemas/defaults only. Then package.json is regenerated once (gains "Models — security" with insrc.models.security.* and insrc.models.tasks.security.review). The repair fixture removes the FINAL taxonomy role so the append rule restores its committed position, and asserts the explicit key order of surviving and appended keys; the byte-identical rerun remains the idempotency check. Idempotent; --check exits 1 on drift. Manifest + script only — no product logic; core-floor and local-only embeddings untouched.

api.name: syncManifest

returns.meaning: Manifest with the whole backend-derived surface regenerated per the v3 contract

errors.condition: Only malformed pkg.contributes.configuration, or a sync-duplicate-conflict (same key, conflicting schemas in duplicate-titled sections), throws; missing group/canonical sections are created, never thrown

preconditions: pkg.contributes.configuration is an array of {title, properties} sections
postconditions: SHARED ROW MAP: catalog rows whose insrc.<path> key is not isPluginLocalKey (insrc.chat.* or insrc.models.tasks.* prefix) drive BOTH update and insertion — the same filter cannot differ between the two

ROLE PREFIX OWNERSHIP: every insrc.models.tasks.* property in ALL sections is deleted; the canonical "Models — per-role tiers" section (first with that title; created if missing) is regenerated from buildPerRoleKeyMap(): key = nativeRoleKey, schema {type string, enum TIER_VALUES, default role.defaultTier, markdownDescription desc, scope machine}; existing key order preserved, new roles appended in taxonomy order

DUPLICATE-SECTION CONFLICT POLICY: duplicate-titled sections — the FIRST keeps title + all section-level metadata; properties merge first-wins in section order (distinct local keys from later duplicates survive losslessly); the SAME key with conflicting schemas in duplicate-titled sections throws sync-duplicate-conflict naming the key and the sections
LOCAL KEY PRESERVATION: insrc.chat.* and any other non-role property survive everywhere, including inside the canonical per-role section
MISSING GROUP SECTIONS: a catalog row whose group has no section gets one appended — no throw
IDEMPOTENT: syncManifest(syncManifest(pkg)) deep-equals syncManifest(pkg); stored setting VALUES never rewritten (schemas/defaults only)

testLevels.purpose: The 6 originally failing tests pass. Guards stay green.
